E1117

`task.all` branches must all be named or all positional.

What

`task.all` branches must all be named or all positional.

Why

D-CONC-ALLNAMED1=A gives named results stable record fields and keeps positional results as ordered lists; mixing the two shapes would make the result type ambiguous.

Fix

Use `task.all { first: work(), second: other() }`, or remove every branch label.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1117: tests/ui/task_all_mixed_forms.stderr.
